$schema_notes: A modular, extensible flora/fauna species registry. Each entry's id is stable across 2D (svg) and 3D (glb) assets, matching assets/flora-fauna/source-manifest*.json's own id field. This set (98 species across three uploaded starter-pack batches) covers a deliberately small cross-section of biomes/trophic roles/taxa as a seed for later growth — it does not claim coverage of all Earth species. Add new entries by following the same field shape; nothing elsewhere in the game hardcodes this list's length.
